Players Committee card image of [[Bow To The First Order (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on table. Once per game, may take Finalizer into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per character, when you deploy Hux, Kylo, Phasma, or Snoke to an [Episode VII] battleground, may take any one card into hand from Used Pile; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter.]”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/bowtothefirstorder_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/d8b70bab5e6d97f961c2744b77242248f4d06b96 d8b70ba] (21 January 2023). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
